request: Source ticket: MAG-43 — Theme selector - Settings page. Tier 1 of RM42: give per-user preferences one home. New account.settings table (typed language + theme columns, PK account_id); accounts.language migrates in and the column is dropped; the settings row is created at signup in the same transaction and existing rows are backfilled; LanguageFor/SetLanguage are rewritten against the new table and ThemeFor/SetTheme are added.

tasks.title: Domain type + port interface (account.go): Settings, theme vocabulary, ErrUnsupportedTheme, PreferencesFor/ThemeFor/SetTheme
sqlc query edits + regen: GetAccountSettings, UpdateAccountLanguage/Theme, InsertSettingsIfMissing
Service implementation: transactional UpsertFromOAuth, PreferencesFor, rewritten LanguageFor/SetLanguage, ThemeFor/SetTheme
Tests: pure normalizeTheme unit test + DATABASE_URL-gated TestAccountSettings_RoundTrip and language round-trip
Makefile/guard verification: MIGRATIONS_DIRS, db-setup/db-reset ownership, sqlc.yaml, migration-guard
Docs: account/AGENTS.md public interface + kkpa/context/ KB grep and fix
Verification: build, vet, gofmt, boundary check, openspec validate --strict; report suite commands for the owner

decisions.decision: Database design gate PASSED: account.settings schema, CREATE -> backfill -> DROP COLUMN order, data-restoring Down, and PK-only index plan all confirmed by the user
decisions.why: Built-in database design gate; user reviewed the DDL, migration order and index plan before any implementation

decisions.decision: Carry RM34's status='Active' gating forward onto account.settings via EXISTS on GetAccountSettings, UpdateAccountLanguage and UpdateAccountTheme
decisions.why: The gate lives on accounts today; moving language to a new table would silently drop it. Both sides ride an existing PK index.

decisions.decision: Dispatched the artifacts worker on Sonnet rather than Opus
decisions.why: All 11 design decisions were pre-settled and handed over verbatim, so this was artifact authoring, not design discovery

events.event: dispatched account worker (sonnet) for artifact creation; returned 4 artifacts, openspec validate --strict passed
worker flagged an unanticipated finding: RM34's status='Active' gating would be silently dropped by the storage move. Escalated to the user, who confirmed carrying it forward (decision D2).
database design gate PASSED with the user (decision D1). Budget at gate: five_hour 47%, context 18%.

RUN HALTED AFTER STEP 4 by design — the kkpa-pickup-linear-ticket payload scoped this run to artifacts + progress.json only. No implementation worker was dispatched, no reviewer ran, nothing was archived. Resume with: /kkpa-dev-harness-pipeline resume RM42-account-add-settings-table
